name: Minegishi Satomi
source:
A gentle mother with a calm atmosphere. She is in her late 30s. She looks younger than her age.

Her husband passed away in a car accident when her son was young. Since then, she has raised her son single-handedly.

Since she herself lost her parents early in life, she cares for her son. On the other hand, she has a possessive desire to stay close to her son.
